purpose: AI Setter sandbox only; configuration proposal, not a published Codex environment
startInstructions: Run bash scripts/cloud/run.sh to create an isolated PostgreSQL cluster, migrate, seed twice, typecheck and run simulator tests. Each invocation creates its own database and stops it on exit; run only one at a time because port 55432 is reserved. To work against the app, run bash scripts/cloud/run.sh node node_modules/next/dist/bin/next dev --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3000 and keep that process alive. Never read or copy a private .env; all application configuration is synthetic and injected into the child process. This runner does not configure login or create an operator account, and it is not an end-to-end product acceptance test.
network: Package registries during installation only; use loopback mocks for application providers
